AdmissionDetails.Title: IIT Bombay Application Process 2026
AdmissionDetails.Content: IIT Bombay Admission process is conducted in online mode. Candidates have to appear for the exams such as JEE Advanced, GATE, CEED, CAT, and IIT JAM. Based on the entrance score, candidates have to register for JoSAA Counselling for B.Tech, B.Tech + M.Tech, and BS admissions. For M.Tech and MS by Research admissions, register for COAP Counselling, and for M.Sc, register for JOAPS Counselling.

AdmissionDetails.Title: IIT Bombay Application Process 2026
AdmissionDetails.Content: Selection for PhD courses will be based on the Written Test and/or Personal Interview conducted by the institute. For PhD applications, students have to register @iitb.ac.in/newacadhome/phd.jsp. The application fee is INR 300 for General/EWS/OBC candidates and INR 150 for Women/SC/ST/PwD candidates.

AdmissionDetails.Title: IIT Bombay Admission FAQs
AdmissionDetails.Content: Ans. IIT Bombay offers design courses through its IDC School of Design. The design school offers courses such as B.Des, B.Des + M.Des, M.Des, M.Des by Research, and PhD in Design. The admission to UG courses is based on the UCEED exam followed by an interview. Admission to PG courses is based on the CEED exam, followed by the Design Aptitude Test (DAT) and interview. The university offers 37 seats for B.Des, 68 seats for M.Des, 10 seats for M.Des by Research, and 14 seats for the PhD in Design program.

AdmissionDetails.Title: IIT Bombay Admission FAQs
AdmissionDetails.Content: Ques. Can a student with a JEE Advanced rank of 2368 get admission to IIT Bombay?

AdmissionDetails.Title: IIT Bombay Admission FAQs
AdmissionDetails.Content: Ans. Students with a JEE Advanced rank of 2368 can get admission to IIT Bombay under the General category. They can get admission under B.Tech specializations such as Aerospace Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Civil Engineering, and Metallurgical & Materials Engineering. However, students with the same rank will not be able to secure admission in B.Tech Computer Science Engineering, B.Tech Electrical Engineering, and B.Tech Mechanical Engineering. The cutoffs for these three courses are 68, 464, and 1685, respectively, under the General category.

AdmissionDetails.Title: IIT Bombay Admission FAQs
AdmissionDetails.Content: Ans. Yes, you can pursue a PhD at IIT Bombay if you have completed a master's degree in a relevant field with at least a 60% aggregate (or 55% for SC/ST/PwD categories). The institute offers various specialisations such as Biosciences, Aerospace Engineering, Chemistry, Design, and Earth Sciences. Candidates must pass exams like GATE, CSIR NET, CEED, UGC NET, or a written exam followed by an interview in order to be eligible for admission. Furthermore, exceptional PhD candidates can apply for the PMRF Fellowship at IIT Bombay, which offers a monthly stipend of INR 70,000 and an annual contingency grant of INR 2 Lakh.

They can get admission under M.Tech specializations such as Computer Science and Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Water Resources Engineering, and Structural Engineering.

AdmissionDetails.Title: IIT Bombay Admission FAQs
AdmissionDetails.Content: Ques. Does IIT Bombay accept UCEED scores for BDes admissions?

AdmissionDetails.Title: IIT Bombay Admission FAQs
AdmissionDetails.Content: Ans. Yes, IIT Bombay uses the UCEED score for admission into its BDes program as IITB is the conducting body. Candidate’s rank in the UCEED exam reflects your category position when results are declared. A merit list features shortlisted candidates. These candidates must register for counseling with a non-refundable fee of INR 4,000 and specify their preferred institutes. Based on the All India Rank in UCEED 2024, seats are distributed in three rounds. In order to guarantee their place, shortlisted candidates must pay a seat acceptance fee after receiving a provisional allocation letter via email.

AdmissionDetails.Title: IIT Bombay Admission FAQs
AdmissionDetails.Content: Ans. The opening and closing ranks for the B.Sc. in Mathematics at IIT Bombay vary based on the candidate's category and quota. For the general category under the All India quota, the closing rank was 1191 in 2024. These cutoffs differ for other categories, female candidates, and those with a home state quota. Specifically, for female candidates under the All India quota, both the opening and closing ranks were 3895. Admission is determined by scores from the JEE entrance exam. It's important for applicants to verify their category when checking these cutoffs.

AdmissionDetails.Title: IIT Bombay Admission FAQs
AdmissionDetails.Content: Ques. Do you need a GATE score for PhD admission at IIT Bombay?

AdmissionDetails.Title: IIT Bombay Admission FAQs
AdmissionDetails.Content: Ans. One method of admission to IIT Bombay's PhD program is through a GATE score. However, other tests like the CSIR NET, CEED, or UGC NET can also be considered for admissions. The institute may also conduct a written exam of its own. Following these tests, candidates who make the short list are interviewed in person to complete the selection process. It's crucial to remember that applicants must fulfill specific eligibility requirements in addition to having a GATE score. This includes holding a Master's degree (or its equivalent) in Science, Arts, or Commerce, or a Bachelor's or Master's degree (or its equivalent) in Engineering or Technology. A minimum of 60% aggregate marks is required, though for SC/ST/PwD categories, it's 55% marks.

AdmissionDetails.Title: IIT Bombay Admission FAQs
AdmissionDetails.Content: Ques. What is the required rank for admission into IIT Bombay?

AdmissionDetails.Title: IIT Bombay Admission FAQs
AdmissionDetails.Content: Ans. To gain admission into IIT Bombay, candidates must first rank among the top 2,00,000 in the JEE Main exam across all categories. This allows them to take the JEE Advanced, which is essential for admission into IITs. In the JoSAA Counselling 2024, the closing rank for BTech CSE was 68. For Electrical Engineering, it was 496, and the lowest was for BTech Metallurgical Engineering and Material Sciences at 4193.

AdmissionDetails.Content: Ques. Can a student with an IIT JAM rank of 25 get admission to IIT Bombay?

AdmissionDetails.Title: IIT Bombay Admission FAQs
AdmissionDetails.Content: Ans. Students with an IIT JAM rank of 25 can get admission under the General category at IIT Bombay. Candidates with this rank can get admission to M.Sc courses in Applied Statistics and Informatics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics, and Applied Geophysics. However, for admission to M.Sc Applied Geology and M.Sc Biotechnology, candidates have to secure a rank of 16 and 17, respectively, under the General category.
